messages:
Maya (sec-eng): quick q — we have an external audit request asking for 6 months of auth+access logs for a tenant. Current SIEM export TTL is 90d for outbound exports. how do people want to handle exception for compliance audits?
Sanjay (oncall): we can't just increase default TTL globally. can we generate a scoped export and keep it in a gated bucket with KMS-wrapped key? :thinking_face:
Jordan (platform): scoped export + timeboxed storage makes sense. propose: create export artifact in s3://sec-exports/audit-<ticket>/, default expires 180d, require export-owner approval + KMS unwrap for access.
Lucy (product): auditor needs chain-of-custody proof. do we have an existing approval workflow that stamps approvals into the ticket?
Maya (sec-eng): we do (see sec.runbook/export-process) but it currently documents 90d only. also need RBAC: only "export-owner" + "forensics" role can unwrap.
Sanjay (oncall): how do we ensure queries against retained export are audited themselves? i.e., analyst pulls -> syslog it.
Jordan (platform): attach an audit-record on any KMS Unwrap action. KMS logs -> central SIEM; link ticket ID to KMS operation. also add short-lived presigned URLs so we avoid long-lived creds.
Maya (sec-eng): question about PII — if export includes PII we need redaction or tokenization before export. does the export pipeline have scrub steps?
Jordan (platform): pipeline has a redact stage but it's opt-in. we should make it mandatory for tenant-scoped exports flagged as "sensitive". can add a flag in the export request flow.
Lucy (product): will this affect SLA for audit requests? auditors usually want data quickly. we should add a checkbox in the audit intake form to indicate "contains PII" so infra can auto-apply redaction.
Maya (sec-eng): grant model: prefer timeboxed RBAC changes vs permanent role grants. example flow: engineer requests export -> security approves -> platform creates ephemeral role binding for 48h -> audit logs generated -> binding auto-revoked.
Sanjay (oncall): +1. add a manual override path for incident responders with justification logged.
sec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4123. Reminder: all KMS unwrapping requires two approvers for exports > 30d retention.
Maya (sec-eng): two small asks to platform team: 1) add ticket id annotation to KMS unwrap logs 2) enforce presigned URLs for export downloads and auto-expire them at retention end.
Jordan (platform): I can prototype a change to export-controller to add ticket annotations and presigned URL TTL. ETA: end of sprint if no blockers.
Lucy (product): I'll update the intake form and product docs to include the PII checkbox and expected SLA.
Maya (sec-eng): final call — retention length: for audit requests default to 180d, can request up to 365d with legal signoff. that keeps us distinct from normal 90d exports. any objections?
Sanjay (oncall): sounds good. note: longer retention increases storage cost; finance heads-up required.
Jordan (platform): will draft implementation plan and include cost estimate.
Maya (sec-eng): ok. action items: Jordan implements ticket annotation + presigned URLs, Lucy updates intake form, Maya to add export-owner RBAC playbook and update sec.runbook. I'll file SEC-4123 with the notes.
Lucy (product): ping me if you want a review on the text.
Sanjay (oncall): leaving a reminder here: when we stand up the ephemeral role, add a watch that alerts if it isn't revoked after 72h.
Maya (sec-eng): noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
root_message: Maya (sec-eng): quick q — we have an external audit request asking for 6 months of auth+access logs for a tenant. Current SIEM export TTL is 90d for outbound exports. how do people want to handle exception for compliance audits?
